conduct_curriculum_autonomy_008.evidence: employees shall be guaranteed freedom in classroom presentation and discussions, and may introduce socially, politically, religiously, or otherwise controversial material, provided that such material is relevant to the course content appropriate to the student group and shall increase students' awareness of roles as responsible citizens.

conduct_lesson_plans_009.evidence: The lesson plan format shall be as teacher-friendly as possible. The four (4) components of the lesson plan shall be: 1. Benchmarks, objectives, outcomes, or targets. 2. Strategies (one or two word descriptors). 3. Date(s) instruction given. 4. Date/type of evaluation.

conduct_political_activity_010.evidence: no religious or political activities of any employee or the lack thereof, or personal life style (including sexual orientation) of an employee shall be grounds for any discipline or discrimination with respect to the professional employment of such employee, providing said activities do not violate any local, state or federal law.

conduct_non_duty_hours_011.evidence: Employees shall be entitled to full rights of citizenship, and no religious or political activities of any employee or the lack thereof, or personal life style (including sexual orientation) of an employee shall be grounds for any discipline or discrimination with respect to the professional employment of such employee, providing said activities do not violate any local, state or federal law.
